info.title: Hacker News Data
info.description: This tool reads live information from Hacker News, a popular website where people share and discuss technology news. You can either ask for a current list of stories (like the Top, New, Best, Ask, Show, or Job lists) or ask for every story, job posting, and poll that was posted on one specific calendar day in the past. You can also choose to pull in the discussion comments underneath each story, including nested replies several levels deep.
info.x-guidance: Call this when you need Hacker News content: either a current ranked list (top, new, best, ask, show, job) or every story/job/poll posted on a given UTC date. Set 'date' to switch to date mode; leave it empty to use category mode. Use 'reply_depth' and 'comment_limit' sparingly since higher values take longer. For date mode, if 'range_complete' is false in the response, call again passing the returned 'next_page_token' as 'page_token' to continue scanning the same day.

id.title: Id
id.description: The unique number identifying this story, job, or poll.

item_type.title: Item Type
item_type.description: Whether this item is a story, a job posting, or a poll.

category.title: Category
category.description: The list this item came from, when using list mode. Empty when scanning by date.

author.title: Author
author.description: The username of the person who posted it.

url.title: Url
url.description: The web address the post links to, if it has one.

points.title: Points
points.description: The number of upvotes the post has.

posted_at.title: Posted At
posted_at.description: The moment the post was made, shown as a plain number of seconds since 1970.

comment_count.title: Comment Count
comment_count.description: The total number of comments and replies on the post.

comments.title: Comments
comments.description: Discussion comments under the post, if they were requested.

category.title: Category
category.description: Which current list to pull from: top, new, best, ask, show, or job. Ignored if a date is given.

date.title: Date
date.description: A calendar day in YYYY-MM-DD format (UTC). If given, the tool switches to scanning that whole day instead of using a category.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: The largest number of results to return. Default is 30, maximum is 200.

comment_limit.title: Comment Limit
comment_limit.description: How many top-level comments to fetch per story. Default 10, maximum 100, 0 means none.

reply_depth.title: Reply Depth
reply_depth.description: How many levels of nested replies to fetch below each comment. Default 0, maximum 5.

replies_per_comment.title: Replies Per Comment
replies_per_comment.description: The largest number of replies fetched per comment at each level. Default 5, maximum 20.

page_token.title: Page Token
page_token.description: A resume point from a previous date-scan response, used to continue scanning the same day where it left off.

api_version.title: Api Version
api_version.description: The version of this tool that produced the response.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Whether the response came from a current list (get_stories) or a scan of one calendar day (find_by_date).

category.title: Category
category.description: The list that was read from, when using list mode.

date.title: Date
date.description: The calendar day that was scanned, when using date mode.

count.title: Count
count.description: How many items are included in this response.

scanned.title: Scanned
scanned.description: How many Hacker News items were examined while scanning a date. Empty in list mode.

next_page_token.title: Next Page Token
next_page_token.description: A resume point to continue a date scan on a later call, or empty if the day is fully covered.

range_complete.title: Range Complete
range_complete.description: Whether the entire requested day has now been fully scanned. Empty in list mode.

results.title: Results
results.description: The stories, jobs, or polls that were found.
